method: Real regenerated offline viewer served locally and exercised in Codex in-app browser through supported CUA controls; actual rendered desktop/narrow viewport, new part selection, guide, lift and transport behavior.
environment: Windows; Python3.11.3; Node25.9.0; CadQuery2.8.0/OCP7.9.3.1.1/VTK9.6.2/numpy2.4.6/shapely2.1.2; actual official PrusaSlicer2.9.4; Codex in-app Chromium browser
limitations: No physical print or fit test; generic220x220x250 PETG/.4nozzle/.2layer profile, owner printer unknown.
Digital assembly/model checks do not accept actual adhesive, creep/fatigue, servo torque, cables/FPC, finger access or hardware operation.
observation: Actual final regenerated639-object viewer rendered correctly in Codex in-app browser. Selected tray_left_1, camera_post_left, left_service_carrier_tier_2 and switch_frame_right; inspector showed each new physical piece and its assembly/service metadata. Step3 of16 displays readable structured part summaries and bench assembly instructions; navigation3->4->3 passed, with no [object Object]. Modules1 and6 reached cam160deg; selected module6 displayed16.0mm lift and module1 returned0. Emptytransport mode explicitly shows all6restraint wraps, removedbank/wands/textile and parkedUSB. Desktop1280x720, narrow390x844 and320x568 had no horizontal overflow; visiblebuttons minimum44px. Actual WebGL screenshots saved. Browser console error/warning list empty. Temporary viewport reset and viewer retained as deliverable. Desktop responsive emulation is not physical iPhone testing.
